fixes.explanation: That's right, baker. Daniel tells Belshazzar, “But you his son, O Belshazzar, have not humbled your heart, even though you knew all this.” Just before that, Daniel told how Nebuchadnezzar was driven away from mankind until he acknowledged that the Most High God rules (Daniel 5:21). Belshazzar knew his father's story, and he still didn't humble his heart.
